Ramesh Agrawal | products = Sponge Iron, Power, Billet, TMT Rebars, Wire Rod, HB Wire, Binding Wire, GI Wire, Barbed Wire, Eco Bricks | website = {{URL |https://www.realgroup.org/ }} }} [[File:GKTMTLogo.png|thumbnail|GK TMT Rebars Logo]] '''REAL Group | Real Ispat and Power Limited''' ('''RIPL''') is an Indian integrated [[steel]] and [[electric power]] manufacturing firm based in [[Raipur]], [[Chhattisgarh]], [[India]]. The company manufactures [[sponge iron]], power, [[w:Semi-finished casting products|billet]], [[Thermomechanical processing |TMT rebars]], wire rod, H.B. wire, binding wire, galvanized iron (GI) wire, barbed wire and eco bricks. The main company [[brand]]s are ''Real Wire'' and ''GK TMT rebars''. == History == RIPL, the flagship company of the Real Group, was incorporated on October 4, 1999, as Real Ispat Pvt Ltd, with the objective of manufacturing [[steel]]. It was reconstituted as a [[limited company]] with the current name on May 6, 2005. The company's final products, [[Thermomechanical processing|thermos-mechanically-treated (TMT) bars]], wire rods, and steel wires were sold under the GK TMT Rebars and Real Wire brand names.{{Cite web | title=ICRA Limited | url=https://www.icra.in/Rationale/ShowRationaleReport/?Id=75786 | access-date=2025-02-17 | website=www.icra.in}}{{Cite web|url=https://www.crisil.com/mnt/winshare/Ratings/RatingList/RatingDocs/Real_Ispat_and_Power_Limited_October_31_2018_RR.html|title = Rating Rationale}} REAL Group's subsidiaries are as below. All four plants of the REAL Group are in [[Chhattisgarh]], with its head-office in City [[Raipur]]. == Manufacturing units == * Real Ispat and Power Ltd * API Ispat and Powertech Private Limited * Shivalay Ispat and Power Private Limited * Real Ispat and Energy Private Limited ==References== {{reflist}} [[Category:Steel companies of India]] [[Category:Electric-generation companies of India]] [[Category:Electric power companies of India]] [[Category:Companies based in Chhattisgarh]] [[Category:Energy companies established in 1999]] [[Category:Manufacturing companies established in 1999]] [[Category:1999 establishments in Madhya Pradesh]] [[Category:Indian companies established in 1999]]
